reasoning.step1:
Step 1 — reasoning:

- Identify invoice-like indicators: presence of "Rechnungs-Nr.", "Rechnungsdatum", "USTID", line items, Zwischensumme, MwSt, Warenwert, Gutschriftsbetrag — document qualifies as invoice/credit note (not excluded).
- Determine sender VAT (Sender.VatId): two USTIDs present:
  - "USTID: ATU 22642807" appears near Liefer-/Leistungsdatum and likely belongs to the customer (Psenner GmbH).
  - Contact block for Günthart GmbH at bottom shows "ATU38510009" — this is the issuer/sender VAT. Choose ATU38510009 as Sender.VatId per rule (sender tax ID).
- Invoice date (Invoice.Date): "Rechnungsdatum: 06.06.2023" → use string "06.06.2023".
- Grand total (GrandTotal.Amount): "Gutschriftsbetrag EUR 473,00" and "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 473,00" both show 473,00 → 473.00 (preserve two decimals).
- VAT grouping:
  - Warenwert (Net.Amount) = 430,00.
  - MwSt (10,00 %) = 43,00.
  - VAT rate = 10,00 % → extract numeric rate as 10 (no percent symbol).
- Verify no other VAT groups present (there is a line "Falscher Mehrwertsteuersatz" but no additional rate amounts); therefore single VAT group only.
- Ensure no inference beyond visible data; all extracted values come directly from the text.
reasoning.step2:
- Document classification confidence: High — contains explicit invoice headers ("Rechnungs-Nr.", "Rechnungsdatum", line items, Zwischensumme, MwSt, Gutschriftsbetrag).

- Invoice.Date ("06.06.2023"): Very high — exact label "Rechnungsdatum: 06.06.2023" present.

- Sender.VatId ("ATU38510009"): High — bottom contact block lists "ATU38510009" associated with Günthart GmbH (issuer). There is another USTID ("ATU 22642807") near the delivery block that likely belongs to the customer; selection of ATU38510009 for sender is well supported.

- GrandTotal.Amount (473.00): High — multiple places show "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 473,00" and "Gutschriftsbetrag EUR 473,00"; consistent total.

- Vat.Rate (10): High — text shows "MwSt (10,00 %)" and "Warenwert (10,00 %)"; clear single VAT rate of 10%.

- Net.Amount (430.00): High — "Warenwert ... 430,00" appears as net value corresponding to VAT group.

- Vat.Amount (43.00): High — "MwSt (10,00 %) 43,00" explicitly present.

- Potential ambiguity/risks: The document is titled "Gutschrift" (credit note) which may alter semantics but still provides amounts — does not change field extraction. Also a line "0001 231 Falscher Mehrwertsteuersatz" exists but does not provide alternate numeric VAT group; thus ignored per No Inference.
